title: Company Brain per-user claims manifest (user-claims/v1)
description: Whole-document rewrite published to user-claims/<tenantId>/latest.json in the brain-artifacts bucket. Cross-repo contract with the company-brain reader — change it in lockstep or not at all. Contains NO secret material: no key hashes, no tokens, no passwords.

subject.description: Cognito sub. Null until users.cognito_sub is backfilled; the reader then falls back to lowercased email matching.

email.description: Lowercased email. PII but not a credential.

disabled.description: True for members whose tenant membership is not active. Disabled users are EMITTED, not omitted, so the reader fails closed instead of falling back to legacy group grants.

operator.description: Enables operator-only Brain tools, always subject to the account's own env gates — never widens past them.

toolAllowlist.description: Null = the Brain surface default applies (no narrowing). Empty array = no tools at all. The distinction is load-bearing.
